title: System Design
description: Design systems that stay fast, correct, secure, and available, following Designing Data-Intensive Applications. Start with the foundations (networks, operating systems, APIs, databases, and security), then go from one server to load balancers, caches, search indexes, object stores and time-series databases, replication and its lag, multiple regions, partitioning, transactions, consensus, resiliency patterns, microservices, message queues, and streams, and learn to see inside it all with metrics, logs, and traces. Estimate load, stress architectures in the traffic simulator, and build a storage engine, a JWT-checking gateway, a search engine, a chunked object store, session consistency guarantees, a consistent-hash partitioner, Raft, a circuit breaker, and a saga orchestrator in Python. Ends with a capstone: design a Twitter timeline that survives spikes, partitions, and crashes.
author: FreeKnowledge contributors
